Alright everyone, I understand completely why my skepticism last round, mirroring Scott's, now looks incredibly suspicious with Sam's tragic death. And I appreciate you all pressing me on it. We all know how easily a false claim can derail the village. Now, with Sam's death, it's easy to jump to the conclusion that he was definitively the Seer, and that his killers are now targeting those who doubted him, like myself.
